title: lilium chalcedonicum subsp. heldreichii
intro: Lilium chalcedonicum subsp. heldreichii, commonly known as Chalcedonian Lily, is a subspecies of the Chalcedonian lily, a type of flowering plant native to the Balkan Peninsula. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Lilium chalcedonicum subsp. heldreichii include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
